```plato
//==
// # Voxel grids
//
// Regular volumetric rasters, dense and sparse. All dense grids share one
// parameterization: Origin is the world position of the minimum corner of cell
// (0, 0, 0), CellSize is the world-space edge length of one cubic cell, and the
// grid's dimensions come from its value array. Cell (i, j, k) spans the
// half-open world box
// [Origin + (i,j,k)*CellSize, Origin + (i+1,j+1,k+1)*CellSize).

//==
// ## Dense voxel grids

// A dense 3D raster of arbitrary cell values over a regular grid
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voxel). The grid dimensions are those of
// Values.
type VoxelGrid3D<T>
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Values: Array3D<T>;
}
```
